franklin.name: Franklin
franklin.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Franklin has 3.6 months of supply, a seller's market, down from 4.0 three months earlier. The median sale price is $862,929, up 12.4% from a year earlier, and homes sold for an average of 98.3% of list price. Median days on market is 49, and active listings number 566.
